sources.title: Hermes 2 Pro Llama 3 8B official model card
sources.evidence: Exact variant, Hermes family, Nous authorship, Llama-3-8B base, llama3 license, ChatML dialogue, function calling and schema-guided JSON; text generation examples. Reopened October 27: current card still explicitly names NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B as base, tags this model as a finetune, and describes extra function-call tokens; it gives no separate active count.

sources.title: Released checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 attention/8 KV heads, vocabulary 128288, untied embeddings, float16, max_position_embeddings=8192 and no RoPE scaling. Dense per-layer attention/MLP configuration. Reopened October 27 and compared with the explicitly named base configuration: all layer dimensions match, with 32 extra vocabulary entries (128288 versus 128256); the target uses F16 rather than BF16 storage. No pruning, expert expansion or multimodal component is configured.

sources.title: Complete four-shard checkpoint index
sources.evidence: 291 named tensors mapped to four main checkpoint shards; total_size=16061046784 bytes. All indexed names matched the inspected shard headers, with no missing or duplicate tensors. Fresh October 27 index read confirms the same 291 entries and total_size; the earlier shard-header reconciliation is retained without fetching shards again.

sources.title: Initial April 30 model card
sources.evidence: Initial card already identifies exact Hermes 2 Pro Llama-3 8B variant and base. Its old apache-2.0 metadata differs from current llama3 metadata; current exact repository card and linked base license are used. No explicit public release date appears.

sources.title: Named Llama 3 8B base configuration, freshly compared
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read: LlamaForCausalLM with 32 layers, hidden size 4096, intermediate size 14336, 32 attention/8 KV heads, untied embeddings and vocabulary 128256. Hermes retains these dense layer dimensions and adds 32 vocabulary entries, or 262144 embedding/output-head parameters. The BF16-to-F16 dtype change changes storage precision, not parameter cardinality. This small vocabulary expansion does not change an integer-billion nominal active count.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 6: original Llama 3 8B base comparison
sources.evidence: Freshly read the original May 2025 report. Table 6 separately labels Llama-3-8B Base as Dense with 8B Total Params and 8B Activated Params; section 3.3 identifies the base-model comparison. This is Qwen's original benchmark counting convention for the exact named base, not a Meta or Nous active-count disclosure. Applied to Hermes only through its explicit finetune lineage and matching dense dimensions, preserving nominal integer-billion precision.

name.note: Matches the exact model heading and official launch.

developer.note: Official Nous repository and announcement; card credits collaborators.

family.note: Hermes-series grouping; Llama 3 identifies the base architecture lineage.

release_date.note: Earliest explicitly verified public launch announcement. April 30 dates checkpoint uploads and card creation, not a verified public-visibility transition. May 27 provider listings are later and are not adopted.

open_weights.note: The complete main checkpoint is publicly downloadable; all four shard headers were accessed without authentication.

license.note: Current card specifies llama3 and maps to the licensed Llama 3 base. Initial Apache-2.0 card metadata was subsequently changed; the current exact model designation is retained.

parameters_b.note: Retain the previously verified complete merged checkpoint count: 8030523392 learned parameters across 291 F16 tensors, with no buffers or scales. The earlier header products and independent configuration arithmetic agree: 2*(128288*4096) + 32*(2*4096^2 + 2*4096*1024 + 3*4096*14336 + 2*4096) + 4096. Fresh official API metadata and index confirm the unchanged revision and exact total; no shard reads were repeated. The model name is nominally 8B. Its 32 vocabulary entries beyond the named base add 262144 embedding/output-head parameters, already included in this exact total; separate DPO adapters are not double-counted.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 8B active count inferred through the explicitly named Llama-3-8B base and finetune relationship. Qwen3 Table 6 separately publishes 8B Activated Params for the original Llama-3-8B Base. The fresh target/base configurations retain identical dense layer dimensions; Hermes adds only 32 vocabulary entries (262144 embedding/output-head parameters), which do not alter the source's integer-billion precision. Attribute this to Qwen's benchmark convention carried through documented lineage, not a direct Nous/Meta active disclosure or an exact per-token tensor census. Total remains the independently verified 8.030523392B; active is not set equal to that exact total. DeepSeek-V2 Tables 2/3 concern 70B and are not used for this 8B inference.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only autoregressive Llama Transformer with GQA and gated SiLU MLPs. Config and complete tensor inventory show one ordinary attention/MLP block per layer, no experts or router.

context_window.note: Released config sets max_position_embeddings=8192 with no RoPE scaling; the explicitly mapped base documents 8192-token context/training. This is checkpoint capacity, not a guarantee about every third-party API deployment.

modalities.note: Text token inputs and text/code outputs; configuration contains no vision/audio components.

reasoning.note: No exact-target declaration establishes dedicated reasoning-mode support or its absence. The reference repository scratch_pad section explicitly belongs to Hermes 3. Clear the baseline false; general reasoning benchmarks do not resolve this capability flag.

tool_call.note: Explicit function-calling training and tool-use format; model emits calls for application code to execute.

description.value: Llama 3 fine-tune optimized for function calling, structured JSON responses, and dialogue
description.note: Concise description matches the documented training and prompting capabilities; retained without benchmark claims.

sources.label: Qwen3 Table 6: Llama 3 8B nominal active convention

patch.notes: Complete main FP16 checkpoint contains exactly 8.030523392B learned parameters (291 tensors); 8B is nominal. Active 8B is a nominal lineage inference from Qwen3 Table 6's explicit Llama-3-8B Base convention, not a direct Nous disclosure or exact per-token count. Hermes retains the base layer dimensions and adds 32 vocabulary tokens, below that convention's precision. Current card specifies llama3 despite initial Apache-2.0 metadata. Public launch announcement is May 1, 2024; April 30 is the earlier repository artifact-upload date, with historical public visibility unverified. Reasoning-mode support remains unverified; Hermes 3 scratch_pad documentation is not transferred.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit preserves the verified 8.030523392B complete checkpoint total, reconfirmed by current official metadata and index. Resolves active parameters to nominal 8B through the exact Llama-3-8B finetune lineage and Qwen3 Table 6's explicit activated-parameter convention; the 32-token vocabulary expansion does not change that precision. This is a labeled benchmark-convention inference, not a direct Nous active disclosure or total-to-active equality. The other 12 field assessments are unchanged.
